integrity: All universal assertions are supported by a self-contained algebraic proof. Direct computation independently corroborates only specified finite cases; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to odd truncation exponents 2a+1 with a>=1 and quadratic finite-field Galois involution; it does not classify even truncations, higher-order twists, or distinct centralizer-subring isomorphism types. A historical priority gap for older implicit formulations remains.
title: Odd-truncation centralizer spectra for quadratic Frobenius-skew local rings
